recalled_knowledge.item: t-channel light-mediator propagator: c(q) = c0 m^2/(m^2+q^2), rate factor m^4/(m^2+q^2)^2, q^2 = 2 m_A E_R
alpha = 1/137.036, sin^2 theta_W = 0.2312, m_Z = 91.1876 GeV, hbar = 6.582e-25 GeV s, t_U = 13.8 Gyr
dark photon: sigma_p = 16 pi alpha alpha_D eps^2 mu_p^2/m_A'^4; off-diagonal vector current for pseudo-Dirac chi
chi2 -> chi1 nu nubar width Gamma = 3 G_eff^2 delta^5/(120 pi^3), G_eff = g_D eps tan(theta_W) g/(4 cos(theta_W) m_Z^2), m_A'-independent
A' with m_A' < 2 m_chi decays visibly (e+e-, mu+mu-, hadrons); tau_A' ~ 1/(alpha eps^2 m_A')
BaBar visible/invisible A' searches: eps <~ 1e-3 for 0.02-10 GeV
NA48/2 pi0 -> gamma A': eps <~ (0.5-1)e-3 for 10-70 MeV
beam dumps E137/E141/E774/Orsay/NuCal/CHARM exclude roughly eps 1e-8..1e-5 for m_A' <~ 0.1 GeV, narrowing to ~(1-3)e-6 near 0.3-0.4 GeV
LHCb prompt/displaced A' -> mu mu limits (eps^2 ~ 1e-7..1e-6 in 0.21-70 GeV; displaced eps ~ 1e-5..1e-4 near 0.21-0.35 GeV); FASER eps ~ 3e-5..1e-4 for 17-70 MeV
asymmetric pseudo-Dirac relic oscillates into the symmetric state because the Majorana splitting violates the dark U(1)
xenon M-response node near 266 keV (isoscalar) and 284-291 keV (proton-only)

failed_or_abandoned: Full WimPyDD q-dependent-coefficient grid for all seven mediators (~27,000 kernel calls, ~40 min) abandoned; replaced by the validated propagator factorisation (contact kernel x m^4/(m^2+q^2)^2 at mean A) plus exact WimPyDD spectra for m_med = 0.05 and 0.1 GeV at delta = 300 and 380 keV (|dZ| <= 0.007, rate <= 6 %)

Isotope-resolved kernels to make the factorisation exact not pursued (diff_rate sums isotopes internally); residual isotope-mix effect quantified instead (max 23 % at a kinematic edge with negligible rate, rms 3 %)
